text: Efficiency. Conservation. Management. Recovery. Renewable.
They sound the same. They are not.
Efficiency: same output, less energy.
A new I E three motor does the same job with less electricity.
Conservation: don't use energy you don't need.
Lunch break? Switch it off.
Management: plan, measure, and control.
Audits, smart meters, monthly targets.
If you don't measure it, you can't find the waste.
Recovery: catch the energy you throw away, and use it again.
Compressor heat can warm your washing water.
Renewable: it changes where the energy comes from.
Like solar panels on the roof.
Remember: a factory can be more efficient, without a single solar panel.
They are different things.
Your turn. Match each action to one word. Pause now.
A: efficiency.
B: conservation. Not efficiency, because the machine did not change.
C: management.
D: recovery.
E: renewable.
In a real factory, use all five, in this order.
Measure first, then act.
Remember: every kilowatt hour counts.
